testo:
■ If you have 3 or more creatures in the battle zone, this creature gets "speed attacker". (Creatures that have "speed attacker" don't get summoning sickness.)
■ Whenever this creature attacks, one of your other creatures gets "speed attacker" until the end of the turn.
